description: Malaysian Sales Tax and Service Tax (SST) codes under the Sales Tax Act 2018 and Service Tax Act 2018

taxCodes.name: Sales Tax - Standard Rate (10%)
taxCodes.description: Standard rate of 10% on manufactured taxable goods under Sales Tax (Rate of Tax) Order 2018

taxCodes.name: Sales Tax - Reduced Rate (5%)
taxCodes.description: Reduced rate of 5% on selected goods (e.g. basic foodstuffs, building materials, petroleum oils)

taxCodes.name: Sales Tax - Exempt (0%)
taxCodes.description: Exempt goods under Schedule A of Sales Tax (Goods Exempted From Sales Tax) Order 2018

taxCodes.name: Service Tax - General Rate (8%)
taxCodes.description: General rate of 8% on taxable services effective 1 March 2024 (Service Tax (Rate of Tax) (Amendment) Regulations 2024)

taxCodes.name: Service Tax - Food and Beverage (6%)
taxCodes.description: Preserved 6% rate for food and beverage operators (Group B) after 1 March 2024 reform

taxCodes.name: Service Tax - Telecommunications (6%)
taxCodes.description: Preserved 6% rate for telecommunications services (Group I) after 1 March 2024 reform

taxCodes.name: Service Tax - Credit Card Specific (RM 25/card)
taxCodes.description: Specific fixed service tax of RM 25 per year on each principal or supplementary credit/charge card

taxCodes.name: Service Tax - Non-taxable / Exempt (0%)
taxCodes.description: Non-taxable services or services eligible for B2B service tax exemption under Schedule 1
